doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Young Tuxedo and Millie Bond, Sidney Desvigne's band
summary: Bailey names his first band and members who died; talk turns to Sidney Desvigne, Joe Phillips and William Houston leading the band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: job with, eh? Me? My brother's band. The first band I started with, my brother's band, young tuxedo. And then after that, then we got with Chris Kelly. We got with our band. Some of the boys went away in different things. Some of the boys died. Jewel Bond, the chamelecrant player, he died in Alexander. Jewel's Bond? Yeah, he died in Alexander.
Is he related to Millie and those guys or did he?

I don't know if he's related to Millie. Millie used to play with us too, man, the young tuxedo. Millie Bond, a chronic player. Sure. Millie used to like to play with me. I was playing with the old brother. What instrument did he play? The Siddly Days' meeting, trumpet. Bright brother, he looked like a white man. He was sitting at the band. Yeah. Then he met bands. So I don't know if he's playing anymore now. I know the last time he was at the hospital to come see somebody there, he had a cab line running. He was getting old. He was here.
A fella, Joe Phillips, plays trumpet. He was taking Sidney's band. They were pretty good. Yeah. Yeah, Sidney. Sidney, I think. Joe Phillips is a good trumpet man too. You don't know him.
Yeah, I know him from the street. He used to work a lot with Joey Williams.
Yeah, yeah. He's a good trumpet man too. I haven't seen him in a long time. Work with Joey Williams? I haven't seen him lately. Hmm? I haven't seen him lately either. I know.
Yeah, Sidney, stop playing music. He's running a cab line.
Well, Joe Phillips now, does he still have a band?

No. William Houston had taken the band in charge after that. First it was Desveen and he gave the band up and then Joe Phillips taking the band. Then the next thing I knew William Houston, well he had taken it. That's the original band up. Yeah. Of course they've had quite a few, you know, younger musicians in it to date. But some of the fellas who started out with Sidney and Desveen, they still play with Houston. Oh, yeah. Some of them went with Larry, some of the old times.
